title: A Swahili Cooking Class on Zanzibar
excerpt: In a Swahili cooking class you learn to cook with Zanzibar's spices. What you make and where to book.
body:
## What you learn

Dishes like coconut fish curry, pilau, chapati and vegetable dishes with spices from the island.

## How it works

Often with a visit to a market or spice farm, then cooking with a local family or chef.

## Where

In Stone Town and in villages near the spice farms.

## Combine

With a [spice tour](/blog/zanzibar-spice-tour/).

See [pilau and biryani](/blog/pilau-and-biryani-zanzibar/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
